passages.quote:
The Consumer Rights Act 2015 sets out the law on the use of unfair contract terms in consumer contracts.

This guidance for businesses will help you to understand what makes terms and notices unfair, and what the risks are if you use unfair terms. It gives advice about how you can make sure contract terms and notices are fair and transparent.

We also have a short guide to writing a fair contract for customers.
